svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two. Cut 99.5 mm of 50 x 25 x 2.5 mm tube, ends square.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Nothing is drilled in the tube: the two M8 screws run along its

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: inside, so it is a spacer clamped end to end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: File both ends flat and square so they bear on the rim band

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and on the yoke plate across their full face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the 25 mm sides run with the rim band's height; two M8

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: countersunk screws 30 mm apart pass through the yoke plate, the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tube and the rim band, nyloc nuts inside the band.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the length of the two stand-offs matches within 0.5 mm.
